title: Beagle DiscoveryResult wire contract
description: The exact shape Beagle validates as `discoveryResult` in POST /api/worker/jobs/{jobId}/result. Generated from lib/discovery/schema.ts — do not hand-edit.

x-beagle-authoritative-limits.description: Returned with every claim. MILLISECONDS — the field names are authoritative. SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md / DETECTION_PIPELINE.md describe the same durations in prose as perPageTimeoutSeconds (15 s) and jobTimeoutSeconds (300 s); identical values, different naming.

x-beagle-validation-note: URL fields emit `format: "uri"`. JSON Schema treats `format` as ANNOTATION-ONLY by default, so a validator with format assertion disabled will accept strings Beagle rejects (e.g. "not-a-url"). Consumers MUST enable format assertion — with ajv, `addFormats(ajv)` — or this artifact validates strictly weaker than the server.
x-beagle-additional-rules: pages[] carries NO id field. Beagle mints identity as `page-{N}`, N = 1-based index into this array. pageClassifications[].pageId and navigationItem/homepageSelection targets must use those ordinals.
Only the first 40 pages are used (MAX_PAGES). There is no schema-level cap, so a longer array is accepted but everything past index 40 is dropped and cannot be referenced.
pages[].assets[].type is an UNCONSTRAINED string here — not the four-value sourceType enum used at asset upload (favicon|manifest|appleTouchIcon|openGraph).

siteIndicators is an open record (string -> any). Beagle reads boolean flags such as hasEcommerce, hasShopify, hasAuthentication, hasAccountSystem, hasBlog; unknown keys are ignored and absent flags are treated as false.
links[] are resolved against rootUrl and matched by pathname to build the inbound-link graph; only links whose pathname matches a submitted page path are counted.
crawlSummary.durationMs is milliseconds. crawlSummary.limitsHit.timeout drives crawlComplete.
